verdict.rationale: Railway documents instant rollback to any previous deployment version, per-PR preview environments, and an agent that proposes code fixes as pull requests for human review. These cover versioning, review and rollback of deployments and agent-proposed changes, not of automations as a distinct artifact. missing for 10: explicit versioning/history of automations themselves (e.g. scheduled jobs or agent workflows), a review/approval flow for automation changes beyond code PRs, rollback of automation definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.
Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
If the fix is in your code, the agent can open a pull request with the change so you can review and merge it.
